metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\deff0{\fonttbl{\f0 Calibri;}} \f0\fs28 ReaBeat - Neural Beat Detection for REAPER\line \fs22\line State-of-the-art beat detection powered by beat-this (CPJKU, ISMIR 2024).\line \line \b Features:\b0\line \bullet Neural beat + downbeat detection (best published F1 scores)\line \bullet Three action modes: Match Tempo, Tempo Map, Stretch Markers\line \bullet Interactive waveform editor with beat/marker editing\line \bullet Quantize Strength slider (0-100%) - industry standard\line \bullet Multi-track sync with one click\line \bullet Per-item detection cache\line \line \b Requirements:\b0\line \bullet REAPER 7.0+\line \bullet Internet connection for first-time model download (~79MB)\line \line \b Note:\b0 On first detection, ReaBeat downloads the neural network model to ~/.reabeat/models/. This happens once.\line }

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
ReaBeat 2.0 - Native C++ rewrite
- Native REAPER extension (no Python, no server, no installer) - Interactive waveform editor with beat/marker editing - Quantize Strength slider (0-100%) - Four quantize modes: Off, Straight, Bars, Project grid - Multi-track sync (tempo map + playrate + alignment + stretch markers) - Beat interpolation, consistency pass, onset refinement - Keyboard shortcuts: Space, Enter, N, Cmd+Z - Model auto-download on first use (~79MB)

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
ReaBeat 2.0.1 - Cross-platform fixes
- Dockable window on all platforms (Linux XBridge, Windows dual-mode) - Async model download (UI no longer freezes during 79MB download) - macOS rpath fix (CI build path no longer leaks into binary) - ARM build fix (-fsigned-char) - Windows ORT pre-load via shlwapi - Removed debug logging

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
ReaBeat 2.0.2 - Forum feedback round
Fixed: - Long-file detection crash (Alex S.) - chunked audio read + OnsetRefinement skip past 10 min - Plugin not loading on Windows (fightclxb, squibs) - MSVC runtime statically linked - Plugin not loading on macOS Catalina (80icio, reaperfreaker) - ORT 1.16.3 for darwin64 - Apply Stretch Markers silent failure (plush2) - status reports success/error - Tempo Map wiping unrelated markers (gkurtenbach) - scoped to item range only - Tempo Map stretching source item (Daodan #1) - sets C_BEATATTACHMODE=Time - Detect Beats enabled on MIDI items (Mercado_Negro) - disabled with explanation
Added: - Visual download progress bar on first-run (Daodan #7) - "Press N for next gap" hint on waveform when gaps exist (Daodan #6) - Portable model location next to plugin binary (akademie)
Changed: - Beat drag hit-test 8 -> 12 px (Daodan #2) - Gap suggestion lines red -> teal for contrast (Daodan #3) - Docked window auto-activates after AddEx (Daodan #8)

version.author: b451c
version.changelog:
ReaBeat 2.0.3 - Full-code audit round: 36 fixes, 4 features
Added: - Time signature dropdown (Auto / 2/4 / 3/4 / 4/4 / 6/8 / 9/8 / 12/8) - manual override recomputes bars, persists per item - UI scale 100/125/150/200% (click the ReaBeat title), persisted - Cancel button - Detect turns into Cancel while detection runs - Middle-mouse pan + clickable/draggable scroll thumb
Fixed: - Stretch markers land exactly on transients on trimmed/slip-edited items (all modes + multi-track sync now share one coordinate convention) - REAPER shortcuts (Space/Esc/F3) needing several presses, persisting after closing the window (poydepzaj1616) - message pump now runs only while the window is visible - Model load with non-ASCII Windows user folders (bobo198504) + interrupted downloads can no longer leave a corrupt model that passes validation - Detection results always attach to the item they were started on; caching survives selection changes - Confidence measured against actual beat spacing (slow tracks no longer show 0%) - Variable-beats tempo map no longer starts a measure on every beat; markers clipped to the item range - Match Tempo preserves trimmed item length; extreme ratios report via status bar - N key advances to the NEXT gap; ruler double-clicks no longer insert markers; playhead follows stretched audio exactly - Out-of-memory on very long files reported instead of crashing REAPER - Manual beat edits survive deselection; many more hardening fixes (see CHANGELOG)
Requires REAPER 7.0+. Verified by an automated E2E suite driving a real REAPER (tests/reaproof in the repo).
